author: Good Enough
description:
Lightning can strike with little warning, and being caught outside during a thunderstorm can become dangerous fast. Knowing where to shelter, what areas to avoid, and what to do if lightning is nearby can greatly reduce your risk of being struck.

This Short explains how to survive a lightning storm, what to do during a thunderstorm, where to take shelter, how to avoid dangerous lightning strikes, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during severe weather.
title: How to Survive a Lightning Storm ⚡⛈️ #lightning #outdoors #naturaldisaster #survival
